answer: A replica crew cannot borrow one light-gate. An applicant bonds 8.55 POA and draws a single ivory token hung on a south vineyard trellis for 15 minutes. They rotate that token until an 18-bit prism hash of grain-angle, pubkey, and epoch seed is logged by the row photometer in seconds 16-42. 92 aliases would freeze 786.60 POA and need 92 exclusive tokens. Auditors replay the token draw from the seed, regenerate the hash, and check the prism deviation to 0.09 degrees. A reused token, dark window, or hash clash burns 43% and rests that row for 8 epochs.
